newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares creep to new all-time high close.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares creep to new all-time high close.

text.p: Norwegian shares recovered from a weak start on Friday and made small gains to finish the session on a new all-time life high.

Oslo stocks have crept higher all week from a Total share index of 1177.8 points at the close last Friday. Dealers said sentiment was positive in the market although activity has tailed off due to summer holidays.
The Total index hit a new all-time peak close at 1192.62 points, a gain of 0.39 percent. Turnover was a paltry 668 million crowns.
Insurer Storebrand took an early tumble after shareholders blocked on Thursday a proposed merger with Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse.

The share initially slid nine percent but recovered to close six percent down at 44.40 crowns in turnover of 45 million crowns. Christiania, whose shareholders approved the fusion, gained 0.40 crowns to 24.90 crowns.

Dealers attributed a four percent advance to 353.50 crowns in offshore services and seismic group Petroleum Geo-Services (PGS) to a series of bullish analysts' presentations. PGS accounted for 47 million crowns of the day's total trade.
